description: Дългосрочна програма за насърчаване на използването на енергия от възобновяеми енергийни източници (ВЕИ) и биогорива на Община Първомай 2020-2030 г. - приета с Решение № 46 / 31.03.2020 г. на ОбС гр. Първомай is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Дияна Иванова. Coverage: Дияна Иванова. The portal shows the English title as "Long-term Programme for the Promotion of the Use of Energy from Renewable Energy Sources (RES) and Biofuels of Parvomay " (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Дияна Иванова. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
